calculation.description: Contrarian signal equal to the negative three-session mean intraday return. Higher values indicate recent intraday weakness and predict stronger next completed-session close-to-close return. Each asset uses only its own completed observations.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC and ICIR were positive in 2020-2022 (+0.03371/+0.10243), 2023-2024 (+0.04370/+0.13074), and 2025-2026 (+0.04440/+0.13097). The partial 2027 sample remained positive (+0.01971) but weaker and below the ICIR gate; interpret recency cautiously.
validation.methodology: Daily cross-sectional Spearman correlation of signal with next available per-asset close-to-close return; dates with at least 8 valid instruments retained. All 15 tradable benchmark instruments were eligible; observation-only macro series were excluded.
